behavior: AC1: headscale-up and headscale-down are idempotent, the container carries the e2e label and is gone after down, and a machine with no default route stops in preflight naming the cause
verification: bash scripts/tests/test-e2e-headscale.sh && scripts/e2e/run.sh headscale-up && scripts/e2e/run.sh headscale-up && scripts/e2e/run.sh headscale-down && scripts/e2e/run.sh headscale-down && [ -z "$(docker ps -aq --filter label=tsb-e2e=headscale)" ]

behavior: AC2: a mesh scenario refuses to run when the pinned tailscale module no longer registers TS_DEBUG_USE_DERP_HTTP or a guest cannot reach the control plane, naming the failing check
AC3: the Linux guest's xrdp answers an X.224 Connection Request with a Connection Confirm through connect from the host, over the mesh
verification: make e2e-mesh-linux && grep -q '^PASS mesh rdp: X.224 confirm through connect' "$(ls -t scripts/e2e/out/mesh-linux-*.log | head -1)"

behavior: AC4: the Linux guest's sshd answers through connect (banner) and through connect --socks5 (key login), and the kind ssh case is XFAIL #521
verification: l="$(ls -t scripts/e2e/out/mesh-linux-*.log | head -1)" && grep -q '^PASS mesh ssh: banner through connect' "$l" && grep -q '^PASS mesh ssh: key login through connect --socks5' "$l" && grep -q '^XFAIL #521 mesh ssh: kind ssh is published' "$l"

behavior: AC5: the Windows guest's TermService answers an X.224 Connection Request through connect from the host, served by the documented Scheduled Task
verification: make e2e-mesh-windows && grep -q '^PASS mesh rdp: X.224 confirm through connect' "$(ls -t scripts/e2e/out/mesh-windows-*.log | head -1)"

behavior: AC6: a port listening in the guest but not declared in host.services refuses a connection through the mesh, on both guests
verification: grep -q '^PASS mesh refuses an undeclared port' "$(ls -t scripts/e2e/out/mesh-linux-*.log | head -1)" && grep -q '^PASS mesh refuses an undeclared port' "$(ls -t scripts/e2e/out/mesh-windows-*.log | head -1)"

behavior: AC7: after a restart without the key file serve prints enrolled=false and the control plane keeps one node with the same id; an untagged node is refused with node_not_tagged
verification: l="$(ls -t scripts/e2e/out/mesh-linux-*.log | head -1)" && grep -q '^PASS mesh restart without the key: enrolled=false, one node, same id' "$l" && grep -q '^PASS mesh untagged key: node_not_tagged' "$l"

behavior: AC8: ts-bridge discover against the local Headscale API with a per-run API key lists the registered guest nodes
verification: grep -q '^PASS mesh discover lists the registered nodes' "$(ls -t scripts/e2e/out/mesh-linux-*.log | head -1)"

behavior: AC9: no mesh log holds key material, a run leaves no Headscale container and no tsb-e2e session, and nothing under .github references the mesh targets
verification: bash scripts/tests/test-e2e-report.sh && make e2e-clean && [ -z "$(docker ps -aq --filter label=tsb-e2e=headscale)" ] && ! grep -rEq 'e2e-mesh|scripts/e2e' .github

behavior: AC10: the e2e runbook documents the mesh targets, preconditions, the harness-only environment variables, the #183 and HOST-008 mapping and what stays manual
verification: grep -q 'e2e-mesh' docs/runbooks/e2e-vm.md && grep -q 'TS_DEBUG_USE_DERP_HTTP' docs/runbooks/e2e-vm.md && grep -q '#183' docs/runbooks/e2e-vm.md && ! grep -q 'Not covered: the tailnet data path' docs/runbooks/e2e-vm.md
